description: Ministry of Provincial Road, Transport - Western Province - Rules regarding the repeal of Rules regarding the transportation of passengers by three wheelers and taxis
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the establishment of new regulatory rules for passenger transport services (specifically three-wheelers) in the Western Province. It repeals previous regulations, establishes new registration requirements, permit procedures, operational conditions, and compliance standards. This fits the Legal/Regulatory classification as it creates a regulatory framework and compliance requirements for transportation services, falling under "statutory instruments and subsidiary legislation" rather than government personnel/structure changes or other specialized categories.
